Title: Azure Cache for Redis—Enterprise features coming soon

Body.Content:
New features will be available soon for Azure Cache for Redis through a collaboration with Redis Labs. With the addition of two new tiers, Azure users will have the ability to utilize  sought-after features from Redis Labs’ Redis Enterprise product, including the ability to run Azure Cache for Redis on SSD flash storage, access to new data types, and the ability to actively geo-replicate data for seamless failover.

This partnership represents the first native integration between the Redis Labs enterprise product and a major cloud platform, further enhancing user choice and flexibility.
